items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Modal dialog on Base UI Dialog: dark uppercase header strip over a light panel, rule-and-dot ornaments, scrim backdrop, panel enter/exit motion, focus trap and focus return. Optional open/close sound cues.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Compose Dialog, DialogTrigger, DialogContent, DialogTitle, DialogDescription, DialogBody, DialogFooter, DialogClose; use Button for actions via render={<Button />}. Pass `sound` to Dialog to play open/close cues (silent unless the sound preference is enabled; requires YorhaProvider). Enter uses --motion-panel, exit --motion-panel-exit; both are instant under data-motion reduced/off.
